medium-fish-group.x: Medium fish, referred to as any medium fish, is a group of items. These are fish with medium size, not fish with medium difficulty.

large-fish-group.x: Large fish, referred to as any large fish, is a group of items.

drink.x: Drink is one of the two type of buff source of [[consumables|consumables]]. Refer to [[buff|buff]] for more explanation.

legendary-fish-group.x: Legendary fish, referred to as any legendary fish, is a group of items. These fish will require 4 days to breed in [[fish-pond|fish pond]], while other fish only require 2 days. At the appropriate location and during the appropriate season for each fish, their shadow will also appear in the water while walking, without a need to cast your fishing line.

legendary-insect-group.x: Legendary insects, referred to as any legendary insects, is a group of items. These insects will require 4 days to breed in [[insect-house|insect house]], while other insects only require 2 days.

vintage-artifact.x: Vintage artifact is a group of [[artifact|artifact]]s that can only be found from processing [[mysterious-coffer|mysterious coffer]] at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or purchasing from [[black-market|Black Market]]. It is special group for [[museum|museum]] donation.

wind-gem-group.x: Wind gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[wind-geode|wind geode]] or [[mystery-geode|mystery geode]] at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining at wind mine. It is special group for [[museum|museum]] donation.

water-gem-group.x: Water gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[water-geode|water geode]] or [[mystery-geode|mystery geode]] at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining at water mine. It is special group for [[museum|museum]] donation.

earth-gem-group.x: Earth gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[earth-geode|earth geode]] or [[mystery-geode|mystery geode]] at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining at earth mine. It is special group for [[museum|museum]] donation.

fire-gem-group.x: Fire gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[fire-geode|fire geode]] or [[mystery-geode|mystery geode]] at [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining at fire mine. It is special group for [[museum|museum]] donation.

uncommon-gem-group.x: Uncommon gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[gem|geode]]s at the [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining in the [[cavern|Cavern]].
It is a special group for the [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]] offering.

rare-gem-group.x: Rare gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[gem|geode]]s at the [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining in the [[cavern|Cavern]].
It is a special group for a [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]] offering.

super-rare-gem-group.x: Super rare gem (group) is a group of [[gem|gem]]s that can be found from processing [[gem|geode]]s at the [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]] or randomly when mining in the [[cavern|Cavern]].
It is a special group for a [[lake-temple|Lake Temple]] offering.

artifact-group.x: Artifact (group) is a group of [[artifact|Artifact]]s that can be found from processing all types of [[coffer|Coffer]]s at the [[sanchez-brothers-blacksmith|blacksmith]].
It is special group for [[guardian-mural|Guardian Mural]] offering.
4 any artifact are needed for the [[guardian-mural|Master Slime offering]] in the Guardian altar.

fossil-group.x: Fossil (group) is a group of [[fossil|Fossil]]s that can be found from processing all types of [[fossil-node-disambiguation|nodes]] at the [[laboratory|Laboratory]].
It is special group for [[guardian-mural|Guardian Mural]] offering.

ocean-crop-group.x: Ocean crop, also referred to as any ocean crop, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient sourced from [[farming|farming]].

dino-print-group.x: Dino print, also referred to as any dino print, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

Players can obtain dino print by breaking the stones, big stones, gem nodes, and small mushrooms in the [[cave-of-memories|Cave of Memories]]. the drop rate of dino print is randomized and there is no specific floor to get a specific kind.

i: tips: Getting hit drop and rare drop enchant on your tools would boost your chance of getting dino prints.

dino-print-group.x: 5 of each dino prints are needed for the [[museum|museum]] hologram collection.

food.x: Food is one of the two type of buff source of [[consumables|consumables]]. Refer to [[buff|buff]] for more explanation. Due to misnomer, for now, not every [[consumables|consumables]] is considered as food.

jam.x: Jam is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

juice.x: Juice is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. This group has 2 sub groups, [[fruit-juice-group|fruit juice]] and [[vegetable-juice-group|vegetable juice]].
The Basic Artisan in the Advanced Alter needs 1 x Fruit Juice
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

wine.x: Wine, also referred to as any wine, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

mead.x: Mead, also referred to as any mead, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

kimchi.x: Kimchi, also referred to as any kimchi, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

milk-group.x: Milk, referred to as any milk, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

dried-scavengeable.x: Dried scavengeables, also referred to as any dried scavengeables, are a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

fruit-juice-group.x: Fruit juice, also referred to as any fruit juice, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
Fruit juice can be further processed into wine in [[aging-barrel|aging barrel]].
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

i: The item [[fruit-juice-group|Fruit juice]] used to exist, and was cooked by the player in an upgraded Farmhouse kitchen. It has since been removed from the game.

pickle.x: Pickles, also referred to as any pickle, are a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

mayonnaise-group.x: Mayonnaise, also referred to as any mayonnaise, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
4 [[large-ostrich-mayonnaise|Large Ostrich Mayonnaise]] of Osmium quality are needed for the Lady Lavanna section of the [[guardian-mural|Guardian Mural]] altar.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

butter-group.x: Butter, also referred to as any butter, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. You can create butter by placing [[milk|Milk]] into a [[mason-jar|Mason jar]].
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

flour.x: Flour, referred to as any flour, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Currently [[barley-flour|Barley flour]], [[chocolate-powder|Chocolate powder]], [[corn-flour|Corn flour]] and [[soybean-flour|Soybean flour]] cannot be used in cooking ingredients.

fish-group.x: Fish, referred to as any fish, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Fish can be multiplied (bred) using [[fish-pond|Fish pond]], [[legendary-fish-group|legendary fish]] takes 4 days, while the rest take 2 days. Different fish species won't breed.

honey.x: Honey, referred to as any honey, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

Although black honey (as in [[rafflesia-black-honey|Rafflesia black honey]] or [[titan-arum-black-honey|Titan arum black honey]]) is produced by Bee houses and is considered to be 'honey' when gifted, it can't be used as 'any honey' while cooking.

oil-group.x: Oil, referred to as any oil, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
There are no [[quest|quests]] that currently need this item.

cheese-group.x: . Cheese, referred to as any cheese, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
As of 1.0, [[syrup|Syrup]] and [[tofu|Tofu]] are also considered as cheese for cooking and may be a bug.

egg-group.x: Egg, referred to as any egg, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

fruit-group.x: Fruit, referred to as any fruit, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Most can be [[farming|planted]], and some other need to be [[foraging|foraged]].
25 fruits of at least bronze quality are needed to be sold for the « Local Produce ».

mushroom-group.x: Mushroom, referred to as any mushroom, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.
Land forageable mushrooms can also be harvested from [[mushroom-log|Mushroom logs]]. [[pink-coralcap|Pink coralcap]] is a [[farming|farmable]] [[ocean-crops|ocean crop]].

vegetable-group.x: Vegetable, referred to as any vegetable, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Most can be [[farming|planted]], and some other need to be [[foraging|foraged]].
Tomato is also considered as vegetable for cooking.

i: 50 vegetables of at least bronze quality are needed to be sold for the « Local Produce ».
1 spring vegetable of any quality is needed for the « Suki's Green Smoothies ».

coconut-group.x: Coconut, referred to as any coconut, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

insect-group.x: Insect, referred to as any insect, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Insect can be multiplied (bred) using [[insect-house|Insect house]], [[legendary-insect-group|legendary insect]] takes 4 days, while the rest take 2 days. Different insects species won't breed.

mussel-group.x: Mussel, referred to as any mussel, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

clam.x: Clam, referred to as any clam, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

caterpillar.x: Caterpillar, referred to as any caterpillar, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

spider-group.x: Spider, referred to as any spider, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Currently, although [[magnolia-green-jumper|magnolia green jumper]] is a spider in real life, it is not considered as spider for cooking.

edible-ingredient.x: Edible ingredient, referred to as any edible ingredient, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

flower.x: Flower, referred to as any flower, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. Most can be [[farming|planted]], and some other need to be [[foraging|foraged]].

Foragable items can be found on the ground during specific seasons. Each one can only spawn in certain areas of the map. Most are common and spawn in multiple locations each day. [[titan-arum|Titan arum]] and [[rafflesia|Rafflesia]] are very rare and may only spawn a small number during the entire season.

Ocean Crops can only be planted on the [[underwater-farm|Underwater Farm]] and grow all year round.

i: 1 flower of any quality is needed for the « Disguise Wanted ».
2 flowers of any quality are needed for the « Flower Please ».
2 flowers of any quality are needed for the « Fishen Flower ».

small-fish-group.x: Small fish, referred to as any small fish, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

ore-group.x: Ore, also referred to as any ore, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

sea-scavengeable-group.x: Sea scavengeable, also referred to as any sea scavengeable or ocean scavengeables, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

tree-seed-group.x: Tree seed, also referred to as any tree seed, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient. All of these seeds can be found from cutting down trees.
Tree seeds that can be found by shaking or cutting down the corresponding tree with the [[axe|axe]].
Tree seeds can be planted to grow the corresponding trees. They can also be planted in [[greenhouse|greenhouse]].

monster-essence-group.x: Monster essence, also referred to as any monster essence, is a group of items that can be used interchangeably as an ingredient.

scarecrow.x: Scarecrow is a [[farming|farming]] equipment that protects [[crop|crops]] from [[crop|crows]] on a player's farm. [[fruit-plant|Fruit plant]]s and [[fruit-tree|fruit tree]]s are seemed to not require scarecrow for protection.

Each scarecrow protects a different sized area of crops depending on the type of scarecrow. Player needs to unlock scarecrow recipe by reaching certain mastery level or by purchasing the scarecrows from shops such as [[empty-cabin|Empty Cabin]] or [[merit-points|Merit Points]], before it can be [[crafting|crafted]].
The appearance of the [[ultimate-scarecrow|ultimate scarecrow]] is modifiable by placing one of any scarecrows inside the ultimate scarecrow's inventory.
